children: Banking stocks accounted for the largest share of equity trading across Gulf markets in the third quarter, with $30.6 billion in shares changing hands, Kamco Invest says. The sector represented about 22% of total regional trading value, although activity fell 10.6% from $34.2 billion a year earlier. Al Rajhi Bank was the region's most actively traded stock by value, with $6.6 billion in transactions, followed by Saudi Aramco at $3.7 billion and Dubai-listed Emaar Properties at $3.6 billion. The 10 most actively traded Gulf stocks accounted for $28.8 billion, or 20.9% of total trading value. (farhan.rafid@wsj.com)
